The observed significant global haplo- type association of CYP2B6 was attributed to rare haplotypes. Among Hispanics, the two SNPs in IDHI showed a haplotype association stronger than either SNP individually (global p = 0.008), and the C-C haplotype was significantly associated with an increased risk of ALL (OR = 6.12,p = 0.005）.
